An '''individual''' who was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] served as a [[major]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]. By [[9 BBY]], the [[Imperial officer|officer]] was stationed on [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] [[Nur]]. She attended a briefing with three [[Inquisitor]]s and two other [[officer]]s when the fugitive [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was [[Battle on Mapuzo|reported]] to be on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]].

Later on, the Imperial officer reported to the Inquisitor [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] when the Imperial officer [[Captain]] [[Tala Durith]] requested an immediate audience with the Inquisitor. The pair went to Durith, who provided a falsified narrative to the Third Sister as a distraction for Kenobi's [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|infiltration]] of the [[fortress]]. As the Inquisitor tried to expose Durith as a [[spy]], they were interrupted by alarms and the major informed the Third Sister of Kenobi's presence.

==Biography==
===Lead on Mapuzo===
{{Quote|Gather your battalions now and shut down every port.|The Fourth Sister gives orders to the officers|<ref name="Part III" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|female]] served as an [[Imperial officer]] in [[Fortress Inquisitorius]], the headquarters of the [[Jedi]]-[[hunting]] group the [[Inquisitorius]], on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] of [[Nur]] in the<ref name="Part IV">{{Kenobi|Part IV}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim's]]<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Mustafar system]].<ref name="Part IV" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{KenobiDate|III}}</ref> the officer held the [[military rank]] of [[major]] in the [[Imperial Army]]<ref name="Rank" /> when the [[Inquisitor]]s were able to find a lead on the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], sending out [[viper probe droid]]s to [[mining]] [[star system]]s to try and locate their target. One [[probe droid]] was successful and reported Kenobi at the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] mining [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]] before it was destroyed.<ref name="Part III" />

Receiving the intelligence, the Inquisitors [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], [[Fourth Sister]], and [[Fifth Brother]] convened with the female Imperial [[officer]] and two other Imperial officers at a tactical room in [[fortress]]. While the three officers watched, the Inquisitors discussed Kenobi's presence on Mapuzo and the Empire resources there. Once the Third Sister brought up informing [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], a [[Sith Lord]] and their superior, the female Imperial officer began discussing the matters on Mapuzo separately with the other two officers. The Fourth Sister then told the trio to gather their [[battalion]]s and shut down all of the [[spaceport]]s on Mapuzo.<ref name="Part III" />

===Tala's ploy===
{{Quote|I was told it cannot wait.|The Imperial officer, to the Third Sister|<ref name="Part IV" />}}
Vader and the three Inquisitors [[Battle on Mapuzo|traveled]] to Mapuzo,<ref name="Part III" /> Kenobi barely escaping the planet alive. However, the Third Sister was able to apprehend [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]],<ref name="Part IV" /> the ten [[Standard year|year-old]] daughter of Imperial [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]],<ref name="Part I">{{Kenobi|Part I}}</ref> and took the girl back to Fortress Inquisitorius for questioning on the whereabouts of Kenobi and an anti-Imperial network known as the "[[Hidden Path]]" which was helping him and other Jedi. Meanwhile, Kenobi [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|infiltrated]] the fortress with the help of [[Tala Durith]], an Imperial officer who was secretly helping the Path. Kenobi advised Durith to make a distraction, and so Durith approached the female Imperial officer for an urgent meeting with the Third Sister. The Imperial officer thus went to the Inquisitor, interrupting an imminent [[Torture|interrogation]] of Organa to inform the Third Sister that there was a matter that could not wait.<ref name="Part IV" />

The pair then went to Durith, and the officer awaited at ease while Durith gave the Inquisitor a fake story about the Path operating out of the<ref name="Part IV" /> planet<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> and the [[Sertar sector]]. The Third Sister tried to expose Durith as a spy, eventually ordering for her to be taken to interrogation. The room was interrupted by the sound of klaxons going off in the fortress. Checking her device, the Imperial officer confirmed to the Third Sister that it was because of Kenobi, and so the Inquisitor stormed out of the room, with the officer following to leave Durith with two [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Part IV" />

==Personality and traits==
The Imperial officer was a human female with light skin.<ref name="Part III" />

==Equipment==
The officer wore a gray-green [[Imperial officer's uniform]], including an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]], black [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s, and a black [[belt]] with a silver buckle and compartments. She carried two code cylinders, slotted above each [[breast]], and a [[rank insignia plaque]] on her left breast displaying three blue tiles followed by two red tiles in a horizontal row.<ref name="Part IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer first appeared in "[[Part III]]" of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]]<ref name="Part III" /> and released on [[June 1]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref> She was portrayed by actor [[Helen Day]], who was not credited as the actor until the character's appearance in the following episode "[[Part IV]]," directed again by Chow<ref name="Part IV" /> and released week later on [[June 8]].<ref name="D23" />
